title: Bees in the Sousaphone
genre: traditional New Orleans Dixieland jazz (collective improvisation, cornet, clarinet, trombone, banjo, tuba)
subject: a swarm of bees settles in the bell of the sousaphone the morning before the parade, and the beekeeper must be coaxed away from his honey stand to talk them out while the band keeps time
caption: Traditional New Orleans Dixieland jazz, 1920s parade-band style. Cornet leading the melody with a bright brassy tone, clarinet weaving fast runs above it, trombone sliding underneath with tailgate smears, strummed four-string banjo on every beat, sousaphone playing a bouncing two-beat bass, snare and bass drum in a marching shuffle. Dry live acoustic room, tight and lively. Male lead, gritty and warm, clearly sung, with band shouts answering. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 120 BPM, B-flat major. Rowdy, funny, danceable mood. No synthesizer, no electric guitar, no autotune, no drum machine, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - cornet, clarinet and banjo]

[Verse 1]
Tuba man calls me at half past seven
Says there's something in his horn
Put my ear to the bell and I heard a buzzing
Now the whole street's been warned

[Pre-Chorus]
Parade starts at noon
Bees got there at dawn

[Chorus]
Bees in the sousaphone, bees in the horn
Don't blow it, don't blow it, don't blow
I've got a smoker, a veil and a jar
Hold the beat and let me go slow

[Verse 2]
Drummer keeps the second line rolling
Soft on the snare, soft on the beat
Bees like a low note, they hum back to him
I tap the bell with my feet

[Pre-Chorus]
One by one they walk out
Down the brass like a queue

[Chorus]
Bees in the sousaphone, bees in the horn
Don't blow it, don't blow it, don't blow
I've got a smoker, a veil and a jar
Hold the beat and let me go slow

[Bridge - cornet and clarinet]
Honey for the band, honey for the band
Free jars at the corner by noon

[Chorus]
Bees in the jar now, tuba blows clean
Go on, go on, go on
Parade is rolling, the street's all swinging
And the honey is sweet in the sun

[Outro - full band]
